title: AIR-DS generative-UI document
description: Wire format version 1.0. A JSON document an agent emits at runtime to describe a screen composed ONLY of registry components, closed-vocabulary layout primitives, and role-mapped text. This schema pins the SHAPE of the format; the closed-world semantics (component names, prop surfaces, literal-union values, token vocabularies) are enforced by the deterministic validator in @ds/genui, driven at runtime by registries/components-index.json and registries/tokens-index.json. Documents carry no code: event props are forbidden and interactivity is declared as intent NAMES the host binds to functions.

version.description: Wire-format version. This document format is versioned independently of the design system.

title.description: Optional screen title, rendered as the page-level heading (h1) with --ds-text-* tokens.

oneOf.description: Plain text child; rendered as escaped text (inert by construction).

component.description: A registry component name from components-index.json. Closed world: a name not in the registry does not exist and fails validation with a nearest-name suggestion.

props.description: Props from the component's registry surface (own props + enumerated racProps), plus the global structural props (id, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby) and 'intent'. Event props (on*), className, style, and element-typed props are forbidden — element props are filled via child slots; behavior is declared as an intent name the host binds.

layoutNode.description: Layout lives in the CONTRACT, not as fake components (the safe answer to NR-001: <Box>/<Stack>/<Flex> do not exist). The vocabulary is closed and token-named — never free CSS.

gap.description: Maps to --ds-space-gap-<value>; 'none' is 0. The enum here documents the default brand; at validation time the legal set is DERIVED from the --ds-space-gap-* tokens in tokens-index.json.

inset.description: Maps to --ds-space-inset-<value>; derived from --ds-space-inset-* tokens at validation time.

textNode.description: Typography lives in the contract too (the safe answer to NR-002: <Heading>/<Text> do not exist). Roles map to semantic HTML elements styled with --ds-text-* tokens.

slot.description: Names an element-typed prop of the PARENT component node this child fills (derived from the registry; e.g. "trigger" on a Button child of a Dialog). Only component nodes may fill slots.
